Since D is on CB and DB=4, write CB=CD+DB=CD+4, so x/2=CD+4. Also AD=AC+CD=x/2+CD=6. Substitute CD=x/2-4 into x/2+CD=6 to get x/2+x/2-4=6, hence x=10.
